svg.title: Great Outdoors Intelligence architecture
svg.desc: A scheduled task or the Refresh button runs the Python producer. Cache-aware, failure-isolated collectors pull public condition feeds (river gauges, FWP closures, NWS forecasts, SNOTEL, fire perimeters, and avalanche zones) into one versioned SQLite bundle. A deterministic rule engine scores river reaches for fly fishing and writes assessments with reasons back into the bundle. A local Flask API reads only the bundle and serves a React UI that ranks reaches with their reasons and shows the conditions on a map. A separate daily script archives FWP closures, which are not kept anywhere else. Offline trip bundles were designed but never built.
